script exec("import lldb,os,struct
modules={}
for line in open('/proc/%d/maps' % lldb.process.GetProcessID()):
    fields=line.split(None,5)
    if len(fields)!=6 or not fields[5].startswith('/'):
        continue
    path=fields[5].strip()
    if path.endswith(' (deleted)') or not os.path.isfile(path):
        continue
    with open(path,'rb') as source:
        header=source.read(20)
    if len(header)!=20 or header[:4]!=b'\x7fELF' or header[4]!=2 or struct.unpack('<H',header[18:20])[0]!=62:
        continue
    elf_type=struct.unpack('<H',header[16:18])[0]
    if elf_type not in (2,3):
        continue
    start=int(fields[0].split('-')[0],16)
    bias=start-int(fields[2],16) if elf_type==3 else 0
    modules[path]=min(modules.get(path,bias),bias)
for path,bias in sorted(modules.items()):
    module=lldb.target.AddModule(path,'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu',None)
    if not module.IsValid():
        print('MODULE_INVALID',path)
        continue
    error=lldb.target.SetModuleLoadAddress(module,bias)
    print('MODULE_LOAD',path,hex(bias),error)
")
